Package edu.bu.pas.hex.agents

Interface Agent

All Known Implementing Classes:
ATPZSMCTSAgent, ATPZSTreeSearchAgent, RandomAgent, TimedAgent
public interface Agent
Represents an Agent in the Hex game. This agent will be constructed by the main game-logic and then 'getAction' will be called by the main game-loop.

  • Method Details

    • getPlayerIdx

      int getPlayerIdx()
      A method that returns which player this agent is in a GenericGame, which keeps track of the number of players allowed to play that game.
      Returns:
      The zero-based index of which player this agent is in a GenericGame.

    • getMaxThiningTimeInMs

      long getMaxThiningTimeInMs()
      Returns the number of milliseconds that this agent is allowed to think for per move. If this agent takes longer than this budget of time to think (measured by getAction execution), the game will skip this agent's turn and mark a strike against this agent. If this agent accrues enough strikes then this agent will lose the game.
      Returns:
      The maximum amount of thinking time that this agent's getAction is allowed to run for.

    • getAction

      default Action getAction(GameView game)
      Returns the Action this agent wants to take in this turn. The game loop will call this method until the game is solved. Must be a legal action to take or the Action will be discarded and a strike will be issued to this agent.
      Parameters:
      game - The current state of the game.
      Returns:
      The Action the agent wants to take in this turn. Must be a legal action.
